note: GERMAN public-domain nursery-rhyme lyrics for pipeline.kidsong.lyrics (config kidsong.language='de' + lyrics_source='public_domain').

German counterpart of prompts/pd_songs.json. LANGUAGE SPLIT (do not violate): the SUNG/metadata fields (title, description, tags, verses[].lines) are GERMAN; the VISUAL field verses[].scene_hint stays ENGLISH because it feeds the English-trained image/video model — a German scene string would leak into the render prompt. song_style (ACE-Step audio caption) describes the SOUND and stays an English style caption with 'sung in German' appended to bias the vocal language.

ONLY THE WORDS come from the public domain; ACE-Step generates a fresh melody per episode from song_style, so no existing tune/arrangement/recording is reused. Every text here is a traditional/anonymous German folk children's song or by an author who died well over 70 years ago (Hoffmann von Fallersleben d.1874, Wilhelm Hey d.1854), i.e. worldwide public domain. Content-filtered for toddlers: songs involving hunters/guns/scares (e.g. 'Fuchs, du hast die Gans gestohlen') are deliberately excluded.

adaptation notes per entry: traditional verses are trimmed to the channel format (2-4 short lines per verse) and a simple repeated German refrain line is NEWLY WRITTEN for this channel as the singable hook, exactly as prompts/pd_songs.json does for its English songs. scene_hint is cast-neutral ('the three toddlers') so it works whatever cast the channel finally uses.
